svg.title: Flight attendant — Non-binary person
svg.desc: A fictional non-binary person working as flight attendant, wearing a flight uniform. Visible work cue: A two-shelf cabin service trolley carries a small handled cup and has a side push handle and two wheels. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Appearance: short hair, an oval face.
